subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` completion require explicit `final=true`, or preserve implicit terminal delivery and rely on final-only prompt steering?
rationale: Both open PRs address the reproduced bug with credible proof, but they define incompatible durable behavior for otherwise valid current-source message sends; repository history and tests cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Adopt explicit final intent
options.body: Approve this structural invariant, scope the parameter to Codex `message_tool_only`, and require `final=true` only for completed current-source replies.

options.title: Keep implicit terminal delivery
options.body: Decline the new completion parameter and proceed with the narrower prompt-only approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit final intent
recommendation.body: Approve this structural invariant, scope the parameter to Codex `message_tool_only`, and require `final=true` only for completed current-source replies.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged source-reply completion work established the terminal-recognition contract that this decision would change.
